issues.issue: Are the appeals moot because s. 87.5 of IRPA terminated the applications?
issues.respondent_position: Crown asserts section 87.5 terminated all applications, so all appeals are moot.
issues.result_quote: As a result, the issue of whether the Minister could be forced to process these applications was no longer a live controversy.

issues.issue: Should the court exercise its discretion to hear the moot appeals anyway?
issues.result_quote: Having concluded that the appeals are moot, we are not inclined to exercise our discretion to hear them, as we believe that doing so would have no practical effect.
